messages:
Priya R: Heads-up — scheduling a small deploy tomorrow 03:00 UTC (runtime config tweak + canary model v2.1). Low risk but want quick pre-deploy checks and explicit rollback owner. Can everyone ack availability?
Miguel: I can be primary rollback owner. Will monitor runtime pods and queues. Quick smoke checklist I'll run: 
- check /health endpoints
- p95 & error rate on last 30m
- tail stdout for OOM or eviction spikes
- validate model hash on nodes
Samira: I can run canary tests and perf smoke. Test set: `canary_prompts_v2` (50 prompts). Planning to run at +2m, +8m, +14m after canary starts.
Nikhil: QA confirm — no DB migrations or schema changes in this deploy. Load test not required for 10% canary.
deploy-bot: Deploy window reserved: 2025-03-12 03:00 UTC. Ticket IR-4821 updated with canary policy and rollback owner Miguel.
Jon H: Dashboards to watch: `infra/runtime-p95`, `api/errors-5xx`, `canary-quality-score`. Alerts: p95 > 350ms or 5xx > 0.5% should trigger manual rollback. Playbook: https://confluence.redwood/internal/playbooks/deploy-rollback (paste if needed).
Priya R: Quick checklist before we go: 
- [ ] Miguel: runtime pod health validated
- [ ] Samira: canary test set ready
- [ ] Jon H: dashboards pinned and alerts verified
- [ ] Nikhil: QA signoff (no regressions found)
- [ ] Asha: release notes + postmortem stub created
Please reply with emoji or short ack when done. If anyone can't make the window, call it out now.
Asha: I'll do release notes and postmortem stub. Ack. :+1:
Miguel: Validating node hashes now, will post quick commands. Use this to check rollout:
```
kubectl -n inference rollout status daemonset/runtime -w
kubectl -n inference exec -it $(kubectl -n inference get po -l app=runtime -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}') -- cat /opt/model/version.txt
```
Miguel: OK 2 nodes updated, no evictions in last 30m. I can be pager for rollback 03:00-04:30 UTC.
Samira: Canary tests green on staging. I'll start canary test run and paste results in thread.
Priya R: Perfect. If you can all drop a final reaction by +15m, we'll lock the window. Thanks!
